items.title: Template use is not defined
items.whyItMatters: Opened, completed and overridden give very different adoption figures (claim c2).
items.opportunity: Define use as completed without override and report all three.

items.title: Historic comparison could be unfair
items.whyItMatters: Free-text reports lose 9 points of completeness without an implied-element rule (claim c3).
items.opportunity: Fix the stated-or-clearly-implied rule before rating.

items.title: No patient outcome evidence
items.opportunity: Keep claims to report quality and referrer views.

reevaluation: A six-month prospective study with defined adoption and a fair historic reference is sufficient for the department's question.
summary: Three gaps: undefined use, unfair historic comparison, and no patient outcomes.
